name: glass-tab-switcher
intent: A Persona 3-inspired three-tab navigation control with a translucent glass indicator and matching content panels.

a11y.selection: Exactly one tab has aria-selected=true and tabindex=0
a11y.relationships: Each tab aria-controls a role=tabpanel labelled by that tab
a11y.arrowBehaviour: Arrow keys wrap and both focus and activate their destination

reducedMotion.behaviour: Selected tab, glass indicator, and panel update immediately without transitions or animation.
